method: Ordinal relevance levels 1-5 by broad tactical position; normalized at runtime over available dimensions. These are transparent starting priors, not validated final weights.

CB.rationale: Central defenders are evaluated primarily through defensive contribution, with secondary build-up/progression evidence.

FB_WB.rationale: Full-backs and wing-backs combine defensive work with progression and attacking support.

DM_CM.rationale: Central midfield roles are centered on progression/creation with meaningful defensive contribution.

AM_W.rationale: Advanced midfielders and wingers are evaluated mainly on threat, creation and finishing contribution.

ST.rationale: Strikers are evaluated primarily on finishing and attacking threat, with creation as secondary evidence.

OTHER_OUTFIELD.rationale: Fallback only. Equal relevance prevents hidden assumptions when the source role cannot be mapped.

guardrails: Weights are generated by normalizing ordinal relevance levels, not copied from a proprietary rating.
A score requires at least 3 available dimensions.
Required core dimensions must be observed for mapped position groups.
Missing dimensions are not imputed; available weights are renormalized.
Confidence is evidence coverage of intended positional weight, not a probability of correctness.
These priors require sensitivity validation before any product deployment.
